name: Opentrons OT-2 automation of protein crystallisation scale-up (DeRoo et al., SLAS Technology 2025)
brief: Crystallography sample preparation: a single benchtop liquid-handling robot with a custom adapter and module sets up sitting-drop scale-up crystallisation plates (4 microlitre drops) with a humidity-controlled deck, replacing manual pipetting of crystal growth reproducibility trials.

cost.original: A single OT-2 costs $13,500 at the time of this writing (2025)
cost.excludes_note: One robot only; adapter, custom module, humidifier and consumables excluded. The paper compares with a Gryphon crystallisation robot at $55,000-$75,000.

notes: price_basis=base, set from the source wording ("A single OT-2 costs $13,500") before base/configured catalog prices were researched. Single-instrument price check: the reported figure is one OT-2 with pipettes/modules, so this tests the catalog price band, not whole-lab design. includes covers 'instruments' because the catalog files liquid handlers there. Verified 3 Oct 2026 via Europe PMC full text (PMC12229254): "A single OT-2 costs $13,500 at the time of this writing, significantly cheaper than a Gryphon machine priced at $55,000-$75,000." This is an instrument price rather than a lab total, so it is a weak validation point; included as the only crystallography case with a stated hardware price. Searches for XChem build cost, the Shifter crystal harvester (Wright et al. 2021, no price in text) and S10 crystallisation awards found no usable lab-level figure.

equipment.rationale: The single OT-2 the paper prices.
